body_markdown:
PLEASANTON, Calif.


, Sept. 1, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- **[Workday, Inc.](https://www.workday.com/)** (NASDAQ: WDAY), the enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, today announced that it will host its financial analyst day on Tuesday, October 13, 2026 in Las Vegas at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time / 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The event will take place during[Workday Rising](https://rising.workday.com/us.html) , which brings Workday customers, partners, and innovators together to see agentic HR and finance in action.


A live webcast of the event will be available on the **[Workday Investor Relations site](https://app.webinar.net/yvLZq4dqd9P)** . The replay of the webcast will be available for a minimum of 90 days after the conference call.


**About Workday**
[Workday](https://www.workday.com/en-us/homepage.html) operates at the heart of the enterprise – HR, finance, and IT – where the margin for error is effectively zero. By tightly coupling AI with the context, guardrails, and trusted processes that run the business, Workday goes beyond AI that assists with work to agents that are capable of driving measurable outcomes. More than 11,500 organizations worldwide, including more than 65% of the Fortune 500, trust Workday to deliver. For more information about Workday, visit[workday.com](https://www.workday.com/) .
